'''2015 San Diego Grand Prix Results Nathan Trothing LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nathan Trothing]] at [[2015 San Diego Grand Prix]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Nathan Trothing]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 San Diego Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
